GrimAge and DunedinPACE DNA methylation clocks were measured directly in a longitudinal cohort and linked to childhood socioeconomic status exposure and midlife insulin resistance.
DNA methylation age acceleration was measured directly from blood samples in a prospective cohort of women following the Deepwater Horizon oil spill and linked to PTSD risk.
The DunedinPACE DNA methylation clock was measured directly from monocyte DNA in a multiethnic cohort and linked to neighborhood/individual socioeconomic and lifestyle exposures.
GrimAge2, a salivary DNA methylation clock, was measured directly in a cross-sectional cohort of Black and White women and linked to dietary nutrient/sugar-intake exposure.
Salivary DNAm-derived DunedinPACE and CRP biomarkers were measured directly in a secondary analysis of a randomized clinical trial of a telehealth parenting intervention (iPCIT).
Blood DNA methylation was assayed across 16 epigenetic clocks in a nationally representative cohort and linked to sociodemographic and lifestyle exposures such as smoking and obesity.

PTPRT promoter methylation was measured directly by methylation-specific PCR in tumor samples from a retrospective cohort of head-and-neck cancer patients, evaluated as a treatment-response biomarker.
Blood DNA methylation clocks (PC GrimAge, PC PhenoAge, DunedinPACE) were measured directly in a registered twin dietary-intervention trial comparing vegan vs omnivorous diets.
Methylated septin9 was measured directly in plasma of a prospectively enrolled cohort of CRC, polyp, and healthy subjects and compared with other blood markers for CRC diagnosis.

PC-GrimAge and DunedinPACE DNA methylation clocks were measured directly in a cohort of 278 African American adults and linked to smoking/drinking exposure via digital PCR assays.
MGMT promoter methylation was measured directly in tumor tissue from a multicenter retrospective cohort of diffuse midline glioma patients as part of the reported prognostic-factor analysis.
DNA methylation of PPARGC1A, HLA-DQA1, and ADCY3 was measured by bisulfite pyrosequencing in a nested case-control cohort of pregnant women and linked to diet and physical-activity exposure.
Blood DNA methylation (existing individual-level methylation-database data) was compared between neurodegenerative-disease patients and healthy controls to identify candidate biomarkers.
Saliva genome-wide DNA methylation was measured directly in a cohort of youth with PTSD and analyzed in relation to psychotherapy treatment-response outcome.
A host-gene DNA methylation panel was measured directly in a cohort of HPV-positive women referred for colposcopy and used for cervical-cancer screening triage.
IRAK-3 methylation index was measured directly in a cross-sectional cohort of MS patients (active, remission, controls) and used to predict relapse risk.

Only the H3K27M and TP53 mutation status of these thalamic diffuse midline gliomas is reported; no directly measured DNA methylation, histone-modification level, or other epigenetic marker is described.

CDX1 gene promoter methylation was measured directly by MethyLight PCR in stool samples of a case-control cohort of 50 CRC patients vs 50 healthy individuals.
Genome-wide DNA methylation (EPIC array) of complement genes was measured directly in liver biopsies across a cohort spanning healthy, steatosis, and MASH severity groups.
Androgen-receptor ChIP-seq assesses transcription-factor DNA binding, which is not a directly measured DNA methylation, histone-modification, or chromatin-state mark as defined by the instrument.

CpG island methylator phenotype (CIMP) status and LINE-1 methylation were measured directly in tumor tissue from a prospective biobank cohort of 1347 colorectal carcinomas and linked to mortality risk.
Genome-wide cfDNA methylation was measured directly by cfMeDIP-seq in a case-control cohort of 150 gastric cancer patients vs 100 healthy controls for early detection.
Epigenome-wide blood DNA methylation (850K array) was measured directly in a cross-sectional cohort of 272 adolescents and linked to childhood urinary fluoride exposure.

Single-cell RNA-sequencing measured gene expression (including of the chromatin-protein-encoding gene HMGA1) in MDS bone marrow; no direct chromatin-state or methylation measurement was performed.

AHRR cg05575921 methylation was measured directly in peripheral blood across four pooled population cohorts and linked to non-cigarette tobacco exposure and respiratory outcomes.
Y-chromosome loss (aneuploidy) and KDM5D gene expression were assessed by SNP microarray/expression analysis; no directly measured DNA methylation or histone-modification level is reported.
Cell-free DNA methylation profiles were measured directly in a case-control cohort (49 colon cancer patients vs 260 healthy controls) for non-invasive screening and monitoring.

This is a study of benzodiazepine prescription patterns after traumatic brain injury; no epigenetic marker was measured.

BDNF gene promoter methylation was measured directly by MassARRAY in blood from a randomized trial of acupuncture plus paroxetine vs paroxetine alone for depression.

Whole-genome bisulfite and 5-hydroxymethylcytosine sequencing directly measured DNA methylation in 80 metastatic prostate cancer biopsies, linked to chromatin structure and treatment response to AR inhibitors.
Biological age (KDM and PhenoAge) in this UK Biobank endometrial-cancer study is calculated from clinical biomarkers, not DNA methylation, so no epigenetic marker was measured.

APOE 5'UTR methylation was measured directly by pyrosequencing in PBMCs and hippocampus of a case-control cohort of Alzheimer's disease patients vs healthy controls.
Plasma cfDNA methylation markers were measured directly in a case-control cohort of 733 cancer patients vs 500 healthy controls (TOTEM) for multi-cancer detection and localization.
DNA methylation-derived epigenetic clocks (EPIC array) were measured directly in a cohort of type 2 diabetes patients and linked to long-term mortality risk.
The denture-wearing and epigenetic-age-acceleration association is estimated via Mendelian randomization using GWAS summary statistics for dental traits, not individual-level measured data.
Oxytocin receptor gene (OXTR) promoter methylation was measured directly in a longitudinal adolescent cohort and linked to exposure to over-controlling parenting.
RNA-Seq measured gene expression in breast cancer (TCGA); histone genes such as H3C10 are mentioned only as expressed transcripts, not as directly measured chromatin marks.
Drug-target discovery for sporadic CJD uses mQTL/eQTL summary-statistic Mendelian randomization and colocalization analyses rather than individual-level measured DNA methylation.
SHOX2 and RASSF1A promoter methylation were measured directly in plasma of a cohort of 36 lung adenocarcinoma patients vs 19 controls for early diagnosis.

MGMT promoter methylation status was measured directly as ground truth in a retrospective cohort of 183 glioblastoma patients to develop an MRI radiomics tool predicting this treatment-relevant biomarker.
AHRR methylation was measured directly in peripheral blood across a large prospective population cohort (Copenhagen City Heart Study) and linked to vascular disease risk prediction.
This twin study estimates heritability of epigenetic clocks measured directly in blood, but does not relate the marker to a modifiable exposure/intervention or a clinical decision.
A DNA methylation episignature was established in blood from a cohort of 25 individuals with MSL2 variants, supporting a diagnostic biomarker for this NDD.

Commercial methylation assays (QIAsure, Gyntect) and a new marker panel were used on self-collected samples to triage CIN3+ in a screening program.
Biological age was computed with the Klemera-Doubal and PhenoAge methods from clinical biomarkers in UK Biobank, with no DNA methylation assay described.
Biological aging here is derived from clinical biomarker-based KDM/phenotypic age algorithms, not from any measured epigenetic mark.
Whole-blood bisulfite pyrosequencing measured SLC6A4 and TPH2 methylation and related it to brain serotonin PET markers and stress symptoms in a cross-sectional cohort.
SFRP2 promoter methylation was measured by 450K array and pyrosequencing in blood, adipose and tumor tissue from CRC patients versus healthy controls, with prognostic value.
Five whole-blood DNA methylation epigenetic clocks were cross-sectionally related to blood lipid levels, a cardiovascular risk factor, in the Health and Retirement Study.
This is mechanistic work in cell lines and mouse models showing chromatin rewiring at the BCAT1 locus; it is not one of the five eligible epidemiological designs.
A nested case-control study of HPV-vaccinated women measured host and viral gene methylation in cervical samples to evaluate triage for HSIL/LSIL.
This Mendelian randomization study draws exclusively on published GWAS summary statistics for epigenetic age and neurodegenerative disease, with no individual-level data.
A retrospective cohort measured preoperative ctDNA using a plasma methylation-based MCED test to evaluate its prognostic association with NSCLC relapse.
A case-control cohort of 505 participants measured whole-genome nasal DNA methylation to link early-life air toxic exposure to allergic rhinitis.
This RCT compared oral azacitidine with standard therapy in TFHL but did not measure DNA methylation as an outcome, only clinical response.
PCDHGC3 promoter hypermethylation was measured in a cohort of 34 GEP-NEN cases and validated in a multicenter cohort, correlating with survival.
DNA methylation-based GrimAge, PhenoAge and DunedinPACE were measured in a cohort of 1059 participants and related to mortality risk alongside self-rated health.
Genome-wide DNA methylation arrays were run on prefrontal cortex and lymphoblastoid cell lines from early-onset dementia patients versus controls.
The abstract notes global DNA hypermethylation in IDH-mutant gliomas via TCGA, but it is unclear whether methylation was directly analysed or only used as a subtype label.
CUL2 is said to be 'related to' DNA methylation via database mining, but the abstract does not say whether methylation itself was measured or only correlated in passing.
Infinium MethylationEPIC profiling and qMSP validated SRCIN1 hypermethylation in blood as a biomarker distinguishing breast cancer patients from healthy individuals by stage.
A prospective multicenter study measured PAX1/JAM3 methylation in cervical exfoliated cells and compared its diagnostic accuracy with cytology and HPV testing.
TYMP is correlated with 'multiple methylation sites' through multi-database mining, but the abstract does not clearly establish that methylation was directly assayed by the authors.
An RCT sub-study measured leukocyte DNA methylation at candidate CpG sites before and after a behavioral intervention that reduced stimulant use in men with HIV.
Circulating histones were assayed as a plasma protein bound to fibrinogen in critically ill patients, which is a protein assay rather than a chromatin-state measurement.
Serum SETD1A protein was quantified by ELISA in schizophrenia patients versus controls, measuring an enzyme's protein level rather than a histone modification.
Cord and child blood DNA methylation (450K/EPIC) was measured across eight birth cohorts and related to residential greenness exposure.
Blood cell DNA methylation was measured via EPIC arrays in 277 individuals with type 1 diabetes and linked to risk of kidney failure over long-term follow-up.
CCDC12 CpG methylation was measured by mass spectrometry in peripheral blood from breast cancer patients, benign-nodule patients and healthy controls for detection.
A case-control study measured GHRL and GHSR methylation by MS-HRM and related it to plasma ghrelin levels in individuals with and without alcohol use disorder.
This retrospective chart-review study of fertility-preservation guideline adherence in pediatric cancer patients contains no epigenetic marker of any kind.
This RCT of a movement-system-impairment treatment model for neck pain does not involve any epigenetic marker.
GrimAge acceleration, a DNA methylation clock, was measured in two cross-sectional adult cohorts and linked to childhood adversity and metabolic health.
Chromatin accessibility and EZH2 enrichment driving SOX11 were demonstrated in the 21T cell line and mouse models; human DCIS tissue was assayed only for RNA expression.
HMGA1 was assessed as mRNA and protein expression by transcriptomics and immunohistochemistry, not as a directly measured chromatin mark.
This longitudinal analysis of frailty, physical activity and hypertension/heart disease in the Canadian Longitudinal Study on Aging involves no epigenetic marker.
This phase 1b/2 trial of sintilimab plus the HDAC inhibitor chidamide assessed ctDNA/EBV-DNA burden and mutations but did not measure an epigenetic marker directly.
Biological age here is explicitly a clinical biomarker-based Klemera-Doubal estimate, with no epigenetic marker measured in the ELSA-Brasil cohort.
LINE-1 global DNA methylation was measured in a case-control study of CKD patients and controls and shown to interact with metal exposure on CKD risk.
Genomic DNA methylation episignature profiling was performed in validation and test cohorts of NDD patients to resolve variant pathogenicity.
Infinium MethylationEPIC profiling of germline DNA identified a 51-CpG methylation profile distinguishing 256 breast cancer patients from 268 age-matched controls.
Biological age acceleration is derived from the Klemera-Doubal and PhenoAge clinical-biomarker methods in UK Biobank, with no DNA methylation assay reported.
This is a technical validation of a DNA-methylation-based cell-type deconvolution algorithm for ovarian cancer tissue, not an epidemiological design linking a marker to an exposure or decision.
Whole-blood/tumor DNA methylation patterns partly characterized molecular subgroups in a cohort of 230 adult T-ALL patients correlated with clinical outcome.
Citrullinated histone H3 was measured as a circulating plasma biomarker for cancer cachexia, which is a protein assay rather than a chromatin-state measurement.
A multicentre cohort study developed and validated a circulating tumour DNA methylation qMSP assay (HepaAiQ) for hepatocellular carcinoma diagnosis and prognosis.
A case-control study measured D4Z4/DUX4 methylation by nanopore sequencing and bisulfite sequencing for genetic diagnosis of facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy.
An epigenome-wide DNA methylation analysis of whole blood compared youth-onset T2D cases with controls and linked findings to maternal diabetes exposure.
Age and sex were estimated from echocardiographic images using a convolutional neural network; no epigenetic marker was measured.
LDHB promoter hypermethylation and DNMT3A knockdown were demonstrated in HCC cell lines; the human TCGA cohort analysis covered expression, not methylation.

Biological age (KDM, Phenotypic age, homeostatic dysregulation) was computed from 18 clinical biomarkers in NHANES III, with no epigenetic marker measured.
Whole exome sequencing, RNA-seq and a DNA methylation array were performed on tumors from 72 IDH-wildtype GBM patients to compare long- and short-term survivors.
This paper reports only the rationale, design and baseline characteristics of the TALENTs RCT; the DNA methylation age outcome has not yet been analysed or reported.
CDO1, PITX2 and CDH13 methylation was measured by MS-HRM in endometrial specimens from an observational cohort to predict response to organ-preserving hormonal treatment.
A retrospective cohort quantified BRCA1 promoter methylation by methylation-specific PCR in ovarian cancer patients and found it predicted decreased overall survival.

Breast cancer subtypes were built mainly from chromatin-regulator gene expression, and it is unclear whether the cited DNA-methylation-based stemness score reflects a directly measured methylation assay.
Placental DNA methylation (Illumina EPIC/450K) was measured across three prospective mother-child cohorts and related to prenatal air pollution exposure.
Cross-sectional analysis of the Health and Retirement Study measured DNA-methylation-based epigenetic clocks and related them to self-reported food insecurity.
A prospective observational study used a urine tumor DNA methylation test (BladMetrix) at each cystoscopy to monitor bladder cancer recurrence over two years.
A retrospective cohort of 100 grade 2 meningioma patients was reclassified using DNA methylation array-based risk stratification to predict local recurrence.
ZNF536 DNA methylation was explored via public portals and cell-line-trained probes, but it is unclear whether methylation was directly measured in the human tumor cohorts analysed.
Biological aging indicators here are frailty phenotype/index and KDM/phenotypic age acceleration from clinical biomarkers, with no epigenetic marker measured.
DNA methylation profiling classified 49 pediatric gliomatosis cerebri tumors into molecular subclasses with prognostic and diagnostic significance.
Cell-free DNA methylation of CDKN2A/p16INK4A and RB1 was measured in blood and tumor tissue from 15 breast cancer patients across two post-surgical timepoints to monitor recurrence.
ZNF331 promoter methylation was measured by bisulphite PCR in tumor tissue from 385 stage III colon cancer patients treated within a randomized adjuvant chemotherapy trial.
This retrospective study of venetoclax plus hypomethylating agents in MDS analyzed clinical response and mutations but did not measure DNA methylation directly.
A nested case-control EWAS measured DNA methylation in prediagnostic oral rinse samples using the MethylationEPIC array to study lung cancer in never smokers.
This RCT used the sperm chromatin structure assay to measure sperm DNA fragmentation, which reflects DNA strand breakage rather than a regulatory epigenetic mark.
Biological aging (KDM, PhenoAge, homeostatic dysregulation) was derived from clinical biomarkers in NHANES, with no epigenetic marker measured for periodontitis.
ATAC-seq measured chromatin accessibility in iPSC-derived motor neuron cultures from 380 ALS patients and 80 controls, predicting disease progression rate.
This study compares prostate cancer risk classification systems against PSMA PET/CT metastasis detection and involves no epigenetic marker.
Plasma ctDNA HAND1 and SEPT9 methylation were measured by qMS-PCR in a case-control comparison of CRC patients and healthy individuals for diagnostic biomarker evaluation.
Phenotypic Age here is generated from chronological age and nine clinical biomarkers, not from DNA methylation, in this UK Biobank cancer-risk study.
A multicenter prospective trial measured methylated vimentin and cyclin A1 (EsoGuard) in esophageal balloon samples to detect Barrett's esophagus and adenocarcinoma.
GNAL expression is stated to be associated with DNA methylation via public cohort analyses, but the abstract does not clarify whether methylation itself was directly assayed.
This study evaluates the evidence levels underlying ESMO clinical practice guideline recommendations and contains no epigenetic marker.
A cross-sectional analysis measured host gene (ASCL1, FMN2) DNA methylation by pyrosequencing in anal samples from people with HIV to evaluate HSIL screening.
Biological age in this longitudinal alcohol study is computed by the Klemera-Doubal clinical-biomarker method, with no epigenetic marker measured.
DNA methylation-based epigenetic clocks (Horvath, Hannum, PhenoAge, GrimAge, DunedinPACE) were measured in blood from adults with sickle cell disease and linked to symptom burden.
Plasma SIRT7, a histone deacetylase, was measured as a circulating protein by ELISA in hypertensive patients versus controls, not as a chromatin modification.
Citrullinated histone H3 was measured as a serum NETosis biomarker in an anesthesia RCT, which is a protein assay rather than a chromatin-state measurement.
This clinicopathological comparison of two adenocarcinoma subtypes mentions 'coarse chromatin' only as a morphological feature on histology, not as a measured epigenetic marker.
A streamlined urine-based PENK methylation test (EarlyTect BCD) was validated in retrospective and prospective cohorts for noninvasive bladder cancer detection.
ChIP and chromatin conformation capture assays showing rs4925102 regulates RAI1 were performed in human cell lines (including SH-SY5Y), not in human participant tissue.
DNA methylation profiles from fresh-frozen tumor biopsies were integrated with expression and proteomic data to predict breast cancer response to chemotherapy and bevacizumab.
A cluster-randomized WASH and nutrition trial in Bangladesh measured NR3C1 promoter methylation in children as a prespecified epigenetic programming outcome.
The abstract is absent, so it cannot be confirmed from the record itself whether the stool Syndecan-2 methylation test study meets the design and marker criteria.
Transcriptomic analysis of CDIN1 variants mentioned disruption of 'histone regulation' only as a pathway finding, not as a directly measured epigenetic marker.
A case-control study measured IL10 gene methylation in children with and without asthma and found an association with maternal smoking habits.
This multicenter cohort study of pediatric craniopharyngioma endocrine and metabolic outcomes contains no epigenetic marker.
This xQTL analysis integrates published GWAS and QTL summary statistics (including methylation QTLs) across neuropsychiatric disorders, with no individual-level data analysed.
An epigenome-wide association study measured brain tissue DNA methylation in an autopsy cohort of 159 donors and linked it to neighborhood deprivation.
Biological and phenotypic age here are assessed using clinical biomarkers in NHANES, with no DNA methylation or other epigenetic marker measured.
Histone marks are cited only as public ChromHMM/ENCODE regulatory annotations supporting a genetic variant's function, not as a marker measured in this study's participants.
Cord and later-life blood DNA methylation (Illumina 450K) was measured in an ALSPAC cohort and examined for association with mode of birth.
A sibling-comparison cross-sectional design measured global and gene-specific DNA methylation and linked it to maternal smoking during pregnancy exposure.
This study examines concomitant gene mutations (including in DNA methylation and histone methylation genes) in CN-AML, which is mutation status, not a measured epigenetic mark.
DNA methylation-based epigenetic age metrics (PCGrimAge, PCPhenoAge, DunedinPACE) were measured in a twin registry cohort and linked to type 2 diabetes and glycemic traits.
